From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@brightseed.ai>; ProcureOps <procure-ops@brightseed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & ask: pricing band + per-model volume split for pilot

Alex / team — thanks again for the call earlier. Short recap and requests so we can get the procurement side moving: 

1) Summary of what we heard from you:
- Pilot target: 8–12M tokens/month in month 1, ramp to ~40M tokens/month by month 3 if latency/quality meet expectations.
- Primary use: conversational assistance (chat) for customer support agents + periodic embeddings for search/semantic routing + small rerank workload on search results.
- Target budget range communicated: $6k–$18k/month for pilot months (variable depending on model mix).

2) Our initial unit-econ framing (attached spreadsheet):
- Goal: get you within ~$800–$1,800 per 1M tokens depending on model family and quantization/latency profile.
- Example split we modeled (conservative): chat 65% (system+user+assistant tokens), embeddings 25% (embedding units), rerank 10% (short-span reranking).
- If we shift to an embeddings-heavy workflow (chat prompts kept small + client-side context), estimated blended $/1M drops toward lower end.

3) Asks / next items to unblock procurement: 
- Please confirm expected % split across chat / embeddings / rerank for months 1–3 (I proposed 65/25/10 above).
- Which SLA/uptime expectations matter for this pilot? (standard hosted vs. reserved capacity).
- Procurement timeline: when can we expect an internal PO or signature? ProcureOps mentioned fiscal windows briefly — any constraints?

I've attached the redwood_pilot_estimate_v1.xlsx that shows two tracks: hosted metered and dedicated reserved-year pricing. The numbers are modeled against the volumes above and include a recommended fallback plan to a cheaper model variant when latency isn't critical.

If you can reply with the split + procurement ETA, we will send a short per-model pricing table and an updated MSA for signature.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — helpful recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- Split: current best estimate is chat 55%, embeddings 35%, rerank 10% for months 1–3. We expect chat message length to be moderate (avg. 220 tokens/user-turn), embeddings requests are batched daily for search index updates.
- Budget pressure: we are closer to the low end for month 1 (looking at $6k–$9k) but can expand toward $15k by month 3 if quality is demonstrable.
- Procurement: ProcureOps needs an itemized per-model / per-unit $/1M number to compare vs other vendors. PO timeline is 3–4 weeks once numbers are in a confirmed quote/line-item format.

Also note: security team asked whether usage logs (audit) and per-token breakdowns will be available for the pilot. Happy to get a short note on that.

Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Platform, BrightSeed AI

Jasmine — adding a few quick notes for the line-item table we should send Alex/ProcureOps: 
- Provide two per-model $/1M figures: (1) hosted metered (no SLA), (2) reserved/dedicated (SLA-backed) with a clear delta. That helps procurement justify spend.
- For chat: show an optimized path (quantized v1) and a higher-quality path (fp16 or lightly quantized) so they can choose latency vs cost.
- For embeddings: price per 1M token-equivalent is lower; call out batch discounts and daily index refresh cadence.
- Rerank: usually tiny token volume but higher compute per call — show a per-call equivalent and the blended token convert.

I also suggest we propose an optional staged rollout: start with embeddings-heavy routing (55 chat / 35 embed / 10 rerank -> start 45/45/10 with trimmed chat context) if the customer wants to stay near $6k in month 1. We can include that alternative in the spreadsheet.

Ben
